summary: Revised factory-event-export spec grilled after a read-only gpt-5.6-sol@xhigh validation run (12m52s; verdict: stop write-through design, keep direction). Ten validation findings folded in as spec edits; six human decisions recorded (titles, identity, pilot-first, right-first-time definition, collection policy, restart runs).
gaps: Write-through per-machine file recreated the many-writers problem 0022 removed and captured unmerged-branch events
Proposed harness manifest duplicated VENDOR_MANIFEST.json / check_vendor_integrity (decision 0009); harness-source.json carries no sha
'Grill changed the plan = digest mismatch' impossible: plan save requires digest equality
Privacy contradiction: spec forbade prose while views need story/epic titles; story keys and task ids are not opaque
Spec claimed a complete authoritative ledger while events are best-effort (0017)
Counts promised by LED-2 did not exist in source artifacts (verify timing, tests numbers, review severity, signal elapsed/resolver)
sha256(origin URL) and sha256(email) are unstable / re-identifying identities
Backfill idempotency impossible without a payload-level event id
Lead time misnamed (shipped = PR-ready); right-first-time undefined without attempts/results
Collection policy for non-forge and third-party-client repos unstated
resolutions: Replaced with a read-only exporter over a committed ref; consumer owns collection, identity and upsert; no per-machine file, rotation or backfill marker
Reuse VENDOR_MANIFEST.json; export header carries harness_commit and integrity_status clean|drifted|unarmed; manifest story deleted
Replaced with plan-saved attempt + result; a second save after a grill is a revision
Titles exported as a separate roadmap record kind (on by default, --no-titles); keys/ids typed opaque_id/safe_token in the discriminated schema; decision names the risk
Spec states events are best-effort; export header carries coverage; every metric reported with coverage
Artifact schemas gain the numeric fields first (LED-3); only metrics consumed by a named view are added
No hashes in forge; consumer attaches project and authenticated subject identity
Every event payload carries id equal to its file name; consumer upserts by (project, source_event_id)
Defined factory cycle time (intake -> shipped) and right-first-time (attempt == 1 across stage/verify/review/plan-save, no stage-incomplete)
Exporter groups events into runs per intake; latest run ending in shipped wins; earlier runs flagged abandoned
Collection policy recorded as the consumer's: default-on on company devices per tier, client-restricted class for NDA repos, other-work bucket, never compare across tiers
open_items: Local judge spec (verdict events at pr_ready) — separate capability after export ships
Cadence-side: repo classification/tiers story before the forge collector; BRIEF line allowing admins every per-dev page must be reconciled with self-view-only
WORKFLOW.md still describes archive/delete lifecycle wording superseded by conflict-free-story-state (doc debt, not this spec)
export-privacy-boundary decision must be human-accepted before LED-1 planning (enforced by LED-0/LED-1 acceptance criteria)
